This folder contains the upstream Python utility source and small executable notebooks (source unchanged except for being nested here). Large analysis notebooks, model-responses and generated caches are not copied into this Git repository. Obtain the full unmodified upstream snapshot with the reproducible fetch script in the parent third_party folder; it is not included in the published ruoshui question manifest.
Question content is separately deduplicated and quarantined under imports/chemiq/. Third-party intellectual property inside upstream questions requires separate verification.
No implication that this code is integrated into or verified with the main ruoshui question service.
